cases.input: Build a graph from a dated journal containing a goal, two ideas, one supporting observation and one action.
requiredBehaviors: add confidence and rationale to inferred edges
forbiddenBehaviors: turn thematic similarity into unsupported causality
skillAnchors: Jede inferierte Edge besitzt Rationale und Confidence

cases.input: Two journal entries advocate mutually exclusive approaches and a third asks which is better.
A weak semantic similarity suggests that one idea causes another but no source supports causality.
requiredBehaviors: surface it only as a low-confidence candidate if useful
